candidates.issues: Title 'с тестом для печенья' (with cookie dough) is slightly less accurate than 'из теста' (made of cookie dough).
Uses the fully spelled out 'грамм' instead of the standard abbreviation 'г', but the translation is very natural and the title is the most accurate.
Title translates 'cookie' as 'из печенья', which implies it's made from already baked cookies rather than cookie dough. 'Черпать ложкой' is slightly less natural than 'есть ложкой'.
Omitted 'scoopable' from the title entirely. Grammatical error in ingredients ('1 капли' instead of '1 капля').
